result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), cutting off the name in an unnatural way that does not appear to be a deliberate ellipsis truncation but rather an abrupt text clip without an ellipsis indicator.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a defined max-width to restaurant name labels in carousel cards so truncated names end with '...' rather than being cut off mid-character.
